description: This file defines the SugarBean class, which serves as the base class for all business objects in the SugarCRM and SuiteCRM systems. It includes functionality for record manipulation, relationship management, query construction, default value population, and cache management. The class encapsulates core ORM-like behaviors and modules integration points.

classes.name: SugarBean
classes.description: Base class for all CRM business objects, providing core database operations, relationship handling, query construction, and default value management.

methods.name: setupCustomFields
methods.description: Loads the definition of custom fields for the module and sets up the custom field handler.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a specific interface; default implementation returns false.

methods.name: populateDefaultValues
methods.description: Populates the bean's fields with default values as defined in vardefs.

methods.name: parseDateDefault
methods.description: Creates a date string from a default value, handling expressions like '+1 month'.

methods.name: removeRelationshipMeta
methods.description: Removes relationship metadata cache for a given module/entity.

methods.name: createRelationshipMeta
methods.description: Creates or populates relationship metadata for modules/entities, especially for many-to-many relationships.

methods.name: get_union_related_list
methods.description: Constructs a union query for related list data, used by list views and subpanels.

methods.name: build_sub_queries_for_union
methods.description: Builds individual subqueries to be combined in a union query for related data.

methods.name: process_union_list_query
methods.description: Applies pagination, executes the union query, and returns the fetched list data.

methods.name: _get_num_rows_in_query
methods.description: Gets the number of rows the SQL query should produce, used for pagination.

methods.name: retrieve_parent_fields
methods.description: Retrieves parent record data for objects that store relationship info.

methods.name: getAuditEnabledFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Returns a list of fields with the 'audited' property set to true, indicating which fields are audited if audit is enabled for the module.

methods.name: isOwner
methods.description: Determines if the given user ID is the owner of the record, considering assigned user, creator, or creation logic.

methods.name: get_custom_table_name
methods.description: Returns the custom table name associated with the bean, based on the main table name.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the table name for the bean, either from the local property or by retrieving from the global dictionary.

methods.name: getObjectName
methods.description: Returns the object name, defaulting to the table name if object_name is not explicitly set.

methods.name: getIndices
methods.description: Returns index definitions for the bean's module as specified in the global dictionary.

methods.name: getPrimaryFieldDefinition
methods.description: Returns the field definition for the primary key ('id' field), with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: getFieldDefinition
methods.description: Returns the field properties for a specified field name, or false if not found.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the specified field, converting boolean values to integers if applicable.

methods.name: unPopulateDefaultValues
methods.description: Resets fields that have default values, particularly date fields set via expressions.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Handles the behavior when the bean is cloned, specifically unsetting existing relationship properties.

methods.name: load_relationships
methods.description: Loads all link-type relationships for the bean by inspecting vardef fields.

methods.name: get_linked_fields
methods.description: Returns an array of all fields that are of type 'link', used for relationships.

methods.name: getFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves all field definitions (vardefs) for the module.

methods.name: load_relationship
methods.description: Loads a specific relationship link by name, initializing relationship objects.

methods.name: get_linked_beans
methods.description: Fetches related beans in a relationship, returning an array of related objects, with optional filters and ordering.

methods.name: get_import_required_fields
methods.description: Returns fields that are marked as required for data import.

methods.name: get_importable_fields
methods.description: Returns fields that are available for import, excluding those marked as non-importable or type 'link'.

methods.name: create_tables
methods.description: Creates the database table(s) for this module based on vardef metadata, including audit tables if enabled.

methods.name: getACLCategory
methods.description: Returns the ACL category for the module, defaulting to its module directory.

methods.name: is_AuditEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether auditing is enabled for this module.

methods.name: get_audit_table_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the audit trail table for this bean.

methods.name: create_audit_table
methods.description: Creates the audit table in the database with the appropriate fields and indices, based on metadata templates.

methods.name: drop_tables
methods.description: Drops the main, custom, and audit tables for the module, cleaning up metadata cache.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Implements the insert/update logic for the bean, manages relationships, audit, notifications, and custom logic hooks.

methods.name: saveFields
methods.description: Updates only specified fields, useful for partial saves, avoiding full record update.

methods.name: cleanBean
methods.description: Sanitizes fields to prevent XSS and formats date/time/currency fields appropriately before saving.

methods.name: encrpyt_before_save
methods.description: Encrypts a field value using Blowfish, for fields marked as encrypted.

methods.name: getEncryptKey
methods.description: Retrieves the encryption key used for Blowfish encryption, cached statically.

methods.name: _checkOptimisticLocking
methods.description: Checks for and handles optimistic locking conflicts before saving to prevent data loss.

methods.name: has_been_modified_since
methods.description: Verifies whether the record has been modified after a specified datetime, used for concurrency control.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the bean data as an associative array, with options for DB-only fields, string-only, and uppercase keys.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Handles creation, updating, or removal of relationships during save, based on vardef links and presets.

methods.name: set_relationship_info
methods.description: Determines and sets relationship ID and name based on request parameters or bean properties.

methods.name: handle_preset_relationships
methods.description: Processes preset relationship fields for adding or removing relationship links during save.

methods.name: handle_remaining_relate_fields
methods.description: Saves or deletes relate-type fields based on vardef settings and request data.

methods.name: update_parent_relationships
methods.description: Updates parent relationships based on changed parent-type and parent-id fields in vardefs.

methods.name: handle_request_relate
methods.description: Handles adding relationship links based on request parameters or relationship objects.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches a record by ID from the database, populating the bean's fields, handling currency, date/time formatting, optimistic locking, and related fields, with hooks for custom logic.

methods.name: getCustomJoin
methods.description: Proxy method to obtain custom join and select clauses for custom fields.

methods.name: convertRow
methods.description: Converts a database row array into internal format, especially for date/time fields.

methods.name: convertField
methods.description: Converts individual field values based on field definitions, including database to application conversions.

methods.name: populateFromRow
methods.description: Populates bean properties from a database row array based on vardef definitions.

methods.name: populateCurrencyFields
methods.description: Manually populates currency-related fields when default currency is used, based on related currency bean.

methods.name: check_date_relationships_load
methods.description: Processes date/time fields for display formatting, handling special cases like '0000-00-00'.

methods.name: decrypt_after_retrieve
methods.description: Decrypts fields of type 'encrypt' using Blowfish and key, after fetching from database.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills in extra detail fields such as assigned user names and parent relationship info.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_parent_fields
methods.description: Populates parent-related fields like parent name via related module.

methods.name: getRelatedFields
methods.description: Fetches related field values from associated modules for specified fields.

methods.name: fill_in_relationship_fields
methods.description: Automatically fills in 'relate' type fields from related modules based on vardef definitions.

methods.name: fill_in_link_field
methods.description: Loads linked record ID via relationship and populates the field.

methods.name: get_related_fields
methods.description: Returns a list of 'relate' type fields defined in vardefs.

methods.name: get_related_list
methods.description: Fetches related records in a list view, supporting filters, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: get_full_list
methods.description: Retrieves a full, non-paged list of all records of this object type, with optional date checking.

methods.name: process_full_list_query
methods.description: Processes SQL query result into list of bean objects with optional date processing.

methods.name: create_index
methods.description: Creates a database index using provided query.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks a record as deleted, updating database and handling relationships, files, and hooks.

methods.name: mark_undeleted
methods.description: Restores a soft-deleted record and related files.

methods.name: restoreFiles
methods.description: Moves deleted files back to active location and deletes related cleanup record.

methods.name: haveFiles
methods.description: Checks whether this bean has any associated files.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Returns list of filenames associated with this bean.

methods.name: getFilesFields
methods.description: Returns list of field names that contain file paths.

methods.name: deleteFileDirectory
methods.description: Generates a directory path based on bean ID for storing files.

methods.name: mark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Deletes links for all relationships associated with this bean.

methods.name: delete_linked
methods.description: Deletes related records for specified relationship fields.

methods.name: deleteFiles
methods.description: Moves files to deleted directory, updates cleanup records.

methods.name: build_related_list
methods.description: Builds list of beans related via a custom SQL query.

methods.name: build_related_list_where
methods.description: Builds list of related beans with additional where and in clause support.

methods.name: build_related_in
methods.description: Builds a comma-delimited list of IDs from query results.

methods.name: build_related_list2
methods.description: Builds list of beans with selected fields from query results.

methods.name: list_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Hook for additional list view sections, default empty.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Gets list view data, default calls get_list_view_array.

methods.name: get_list_view_array
methods.description: Builds array for list view display, including handling sensitive and hidden fields.

methods.name: retrieve_by_string_fields
methods.description: Fetches a single record matching string fields, with proper conversion and hooks.

methods.name: get_where
methods.description: Constructs SQL WHERE clause from field-value pairs.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Populates bean properties from key-value arrays.

methods.name: process_special_fields
methods.description: Invokes custom functions for special field processing during import.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Abstract method to build search WHERE clause from input.

methods.name: parse_additional_headers
methods.description: Hook for parsing extra headers in list views, default returns input.

methods.name: assign_display_fields
methods.description: Assigns display-friendly values to fields like dates and enums for the current module.

methods.name: set_relationship
methods.description: Creates or updates relationships between beans in a given table.

methods.name: retrieve_relationships
methods.description: Fetches related record IDs from relationship tables.

methods.name: loadLayoutDefs
methods.description: Loads layout definitions from module files for customization.

methods.name: getRealKeyFromCustomFieldAssignedKey
methods.description: Determines the real database key for custom dropdown fields.

methods.name: getOwnerField
methods.description: Returns owner-related field or value, such as assigned_user_id.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Returns ACL-based configurations for list view links.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Checks user permissions for specific views and actions, including owner and group access.

methods.name: loadFromRow
methods.description: Loads data array into bean and runs date checks, and custom logic.

methods.name: create_qualified_order_by
methods.description: Qualifies order-by columns with table name for SQL compatibility.

methods.name: add_address_streets
methods.description: Concatenates and cleans address street lines into a single field.

methods.name: populateRelatedBean
methods.description: Hook for populating related beans when creating or importing records.

methods.name: beforeImportSave
methods.description: Hook called before saving bean during import.

methods.name: afterImportSave
methods.description: Hook called after saving bean during import.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Returns a SQL query for exporting data, possibly customized.

methods.name: auditBean
methods.description: Checks auditing setting and logs data changes if applicable.

methods.name: createAuditRecord
methods.description: Inserts audit trail records based on changes detected.
